microtheory.name: agriculture
microtheory.definition: Agriculture — cultivation of plants + animals for food, fiber, fuel. Crop science, animal husbandry, soil science, irrigation, breeding, agronomy. From Neolithic origins ~10,000 BCE to industrial + precision agriculture. Borlaug's Green Revolution. Substrate analogue: applied biology + ecology for sustained extraction of biomass.

concepts.name: agriculture_definition
concepts.definition: Systematic cultivation of plants + animals. Neolithic Revolution ~10,000 BCE enabled settled societies + civilisation.

concepts.name: domestication
concepts.definition: Genetic + behavioral modification of species for human use over generations. Wheat, rice, maize, cattle, sheep, dog.

concepts.name: fertile_crescent
concepts.definition: Mesopotamia + Levant + Egypt. Cradle of Old World agriculture ~10,000 BCE. 8 founder crops + 4 livestock.

concepts.name: crop_science
concepts.definition: Plants cultivated for food + fiber + fuel. Cereals (wheat, rice, maize, barley) provide ~50% human calories.

concepts.name: wheat
concepts.definition: Triticum. Global staple. Bread + pasta. Hard (high protein) vs soft varieties.

concepts.name: rice
concepts.definition: Oryza. Half world population staple. Paddy cultivation + wet/dry rotation. Methane emissions.

concepts.name: maize_corn
concepts.definition: Zea mays. Domesticated from teosinte in Mexico. Food + feed + biofuel. C4 photosynthesis.

concepts.name: legume
concepts.definition: Beans + peas + lentils + soy. Fix atmospheric nitrogen via root nodules. Rotation partner.

concepts.name: livestock
concepts.definition: Animals raised for meat, dairy, eggs, fiber, work. Cattle, sheep, goat, pig, poultry. Major land + resource use.

concepts.name: animal_husbandry
concepts.definition: Care, breeding, management of livestock. Nutrition, health, reproduction, housing.

concepts.name: factory_farming
concepts.definition: Intensive confinement. CAFOs. Productivity + welfare + environmental + antibiotic-resistance concerns.

concepts.name: grazing_systems
concepts.definition: Extensive pasture-based. Rotational grazing improves soil + biodiversity. Ranching.

concepts.name: soil_science
concepts.definition: Pedology + edaphology. Mineral + organic + water + air + biota. Texture + structure + chemistry. Living system.

concepts.name: soil_horizon
concepts.definition: Layered structure. O (organic), A (topsoil), B (subsoil), C (parent material), R (bedrock). Substrate analogue: substrate's layered structure.

concepts.name: soil_fertility
concepts.definition: Capacity to support plant growth. Nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium (NPK) + micronutrients + pH + organic matter.

concepts.name: soil_erosion
concepts.definition: Loss of topsoil by water + wind. ~10× faster than replacement under conventional agriculture. Dust Bowl 1930s.

concepts.name: cover_crop
concepts.definition: Off-season planting. Prevents erosion, fixes nitrogen, suppresses weeds, builds organic matter. Regenerative ag.

concepts.name: irrigation
concepts.definition: Artificial water supply. Flood + furrow + sprinkler + drip. Drip most efficient. 70% of global freshwater use.

concepts.name: rainfed_agriculture
concepts.definition: Without irrigation. Climate-dependent. Most of world's cropland.

concepts.name: groundwater_depletion
concepts.definition: Aquifers drawn faster than recharge. Ogallala (US Plains), India, China. Major sustainability issue.

concepts.name: plant_breeding
concepts.definition: Genetic improvement. Selection → crossbreeding → hybrid vigor → mutation breeding → genetic engineering.

concepts.name: green_revolution
concepts.definition: 1940s-70s. Borlaug + Swaminathan + others. Semi-dwarf varieties + synthetic fertilizer + irrigation + pesticides. Tripled cereal yields. Averted famine.

concepts.name: norman_borlaug
concepts.definition: Nobel Peace 1970. Wheat breeder. Father of Green Revolution. Saved estimated billion lives.

concepts.name: gmo_crop
concepts.definition: Genetically modified organism. Bt corn (insect resistance), Roundup Ready (herbicide tolerance), golden rice (vitamin A). Public + scientific consensus diverge.

concepts.name: fertilizer
concepts.definition: Plant nutrient supplements. Synthetic (Haber-Bosch ammonia) revolutionised yields. Runoff causes eutrophication.

concepts.name: haber_bosch_process
concepts.definition: Haber 1909 + Bosch industrialisation. N2 + 3H2 → 2NH3 under pressure + catalyst. Foundation of synthetic fertilizer. Feeds half of humanity.

concepts.name: pesticide
concepts.definition: Pest control chemicals. Insecticides + herbicides + fungicides. Productivity + resistance + ecological concerns.

concepts.name: integrated_pest_management
concepts.definition: IPM. Multiple tactics (biological, cultural, chemical). Reduces pesticide reliance. Substrate analogue: substrate's multi-strategy defence.

concepts.name: crop_rotation
concepts.definition: Sequence different crops. Breaks pest cycles, manages soil nutrients. Norfolk 4-course (Britain) classic.

concepts.name: monoculture
concepts.definition: Single crop on large area. Industrial agriculture standard. Productive but ecologically fragile + pest-prone.

concepts.name: polyculture
concepts.definition: Multiple species. Higher biodiversity + resilience. Three Sisters (corn + bean + squash).

concepts.name: no_till_agriculture
concepts.definition: Plant without ploughing. Preserves soil structure + organic matter. Reduces erosion + emissions.

concepts.name: precision_agriculture
concepts.definition: GPS + sensors + variable-rate technology. Apply inputs where + when needed. Reduces waste. Substrate analogue: substrate's precision-application.

concepts.name: organic_agriculture
concepts.definition: No synthetic pesticides/fertilizers/GMO. Certified standards. Premium prices. Lower yields typically.

concepts.name: regenerative_agriculture
concepts.definition: Builds soil, biodiversity, carbon sequestration. Cover crops + no-till + diverse rotations + livestock integration.

concepts.name: aquaculture
concepts.definition: Cultivated aquatic species. Fastest-growing food sector. Salmon, shrimp, tilapia, oysters. Environmental + welfare debate.

concepts.name: vertical_farming
concepts.definition: Indoor stacked controlled-environment agriculture. Lettuce + herbs commercial. Energy-intensive — economics challenging.

rules.name: neolithic_transition_enabled_civilisation
rules.head: Jabberwock considers historical transformation
rules.body: agriculture ~10,000 BCE enabled settled populations, surplus, stratification, writing, states. Cause of subsequent human history.

rules.name: green_revolution_averted_mass_famine
rules.head: Jabberwock considers 20th-c population growth
rules.body: without Borlaug's semi-dwarf varieties + synthetic fertilizer + irrigation, food production would not have kept pace. Estimated billion lives saved.

rules.name: haber_bosch_feeds_billions
rules.head: Jabberwock examines nitrogen cycle
rules.body: atmospheric N2 fixation via Haber-Bosch process provides ~50% of agricultural nitrogen. Without it, half of humans couldn't be fed.

rules.name: monoculture_trades_efficiency_for_fragility
rules.head: Jabberwock evaluates cropping system
rules.body: monoculture maximises mechanisation + yield per labor; suffers pest susceptibility + soil degradation + ecosystem collapse risk.

rules.name: soil_is_a_living_system
rules.head: Jabberwock manages agricultural land
rules.body: topsoil contains complex biota + organic matter built over centuries. Lost in years under conventional ag. Foundation of long-term productivity.
